next_step: Finalize throughput SLA language and sign SOW draft; schedule POC run window
notes: Top-line: Lacuna runs real-time personalization and RTB features; throughput and predictable tail latency are deal-breakers. Primary ask: formal minimum tokens/sec guarantee for dedicated pool + clear concurrency caps + burst rules and cost for excess. Engineering emphasized mixed token profile (70% short <32 tokens, 25% medium 32-256, 5% long >512). Want 24/7 reserved capacity in us-east with VPC peering; encryption/KMS + SOC2 required. AE raised expectation: baseline min_tokens/sec target ~20k-40k (depending on model family), concurrency cap target 512 concurrent inference streams, burst to 150%-200% of baseline for short windows (5-10 minutes) with auto-throttle. Redwood initial commercial offered: reserved 16 GPU equivalent pool (A100-class), baseline guarantee 22k tokens/sec, concurrency cap 384, burst up to 1.5x for 10 minutes with credit-based overage billing. Lacuna asked for penalty credits (monthly credit if p99 falls below SLA) and ability to scale to 2x baseline for 15 minutes during campaigns. Legal flags: need explicit measurement methodology (what counts as token, measurement window), SLO measurement & reporting, and 30-day notice for capacity scaling. POC criteria agreed: sustained synthetic run for 6 hours hitting 80% baseline, 3 spike tests (5m, 10m, 30m) to validate burst mechanics, and p95/p99 latency charts under token mix. Quote from Head of Infra: "We need deterministic throughput — if peak hits and latency degrades, ad auctions lose value in seconds."
